alerts.name: SMART设备健康状态异常
alerts.note: 硬盘自身检测的整体健康状态为不健康，存在严重故障风险，需立即处理
alerts.note_en: Disk self-assessed overall health is FAILED, serious failure risk, handle immediately
alerts.action:
1) 用 smartctl -a /dev/sdX 看完整属性，重点关注 Reallocated_Sector_Ct、Current_Pending_Sector、Offline_Uncorrectable；
2) 立即确认该盘上的数据有副本或已备份——这是最优先的动作；
3) RAID 环境下确认阵列状态，先让阵列把该盘踢出并用热备重建；
4) 安排停机换盘，不要继续往这块盘写数据。

alerts.name: SSD介质磨损百分比≥90%
alerts.note: SSD闪存芯片磨损程度接近耗尽，随时可能发生故障，需立即备份数据并更换硬盘
alerts.note_en: SSD flash wearout is nearly exhausted and may fail at any time; back up data and replace the drive immediately
alerts.action:
1) 用 smartctl -a /dev/sdX 确认 Media_Wearout_Indicator / Percentage_Used 与 Total_LBAs_Written；
2) 结合写入速率估算剩余寿命，据此排换盘窗口；
3) 确认该盘上的数据有副本，并提前准备迁移方案；
4) 复盘写入放大来源（日志级别、频繁小写入、无 TRIM），避免新盘重蹈覆辙。

alerts.name: 硬盘温度超过65℃
alerts.note: 硬盘运行温度过高，会加速硬件老化甚至导致直接故障，需立即检查散热
alerts.note_en: Disk operating temperature too high, which accelerates aging or causes outright failure; check cooling immediately
alerts.action:
1) 用 smartctl -a /dev/sdX 确认温度与厂商标称的工作温度上限；
2) 检查机箱风道、风扇转速与滤网积灰，机房环境温度是否正常；
3) 确认盘位安装位置是否过于密集、相邻盘是否同样高温；
4) 短期可降低该盘的 IO 压力（错峰备份、迁移热数据）为处理争取时间。

alerts.name: CRC错误计数1小时内持续增长
alerts.name_en: CRC error count keeps growing within 1 hour
alerts.note: 数据传输链路CRC校验失败次数增加，可能是接口、线缆或硬盘控制器故障前兆
alerts.note_en: Growing CRC failures on the data link, a possible precursor of interface, cable or disk controller failure
alerts.action:
1) 用 smartctl -a /dev/sdX 确认 UDMA_CRC_Error_Count 的增长速度；
2) 停机检查并重新插拔 SATA/SAS 数据线与电源线，优先直接换一根线；
3) 换线后观察计数是否停止增长——SMART 计数不会自动归零，看增量而非绝对值；
4) 换线无效则怀疑背板或 HBA 卡，逐个替换定位。

alerts.name: SSD擦除失败计数增长
alerts.note: SSD闪存块擦除失败，意味着闪存芯片老化，存在数据写入故障风险
alerts.note_en: SSD flash block erase failures indicate aging flash chips and a risk of write failures
alerts.action:
1) 用 smartctl -a /dev/sdX 确认 Erase_Fail_Count 与 Reallocated/Available_Reservd_Space 的剩余余量；
2) 备用块余量下降说明盘已接近寿命终点，立即确认数据有副本；
3) 排换盘计划，不要等到写入完全失败；
4) 换盘前降低该盘写入压力，避免加速恶化。

alerts.name: SSD编程失败计数增长
alerts.note: SSD闪存块写入失败，闪存芯片健康度急剧下降，需立即备份数据
alerts.note_en: SSD flash block program failures; flash chip health is degrading rapidly, back up data immediately
alerts.action:
1) 用 smartctl -a /dev/sdX 确认 Program_Fail_Count 与备用块剩余比例；
2) 立即确认该盘数据有副本或备份，这是最优先动作；
3) 尽快排换盘，编程失败通常伴随数据静默损坏风险；
4) 换盘前把该盘设为只读或迁走热数据，避免继续写入。

metrics.name: CRC错误计数
metrics.note: 硬盘数据传输过程中循环冗余校验（CRC）失败的次数。
metrics.note_en: The number of Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) failures during hard disk data transmission, reflecting the reliability of the data transmission link.

metrics.name: 端到端错误检测计数
metrics.note: 硬盘内部数据传输的端到端校验失败次数，关联固件或物理存储单元健康度。
metrics.note_en: The number of end-to-end verification failures in internal hard disk data transmission, associated with the health of hard disk firmware or physical storage units.

metrics.name: 擦除失败计数
metrics.note: 固态硬盘（SSD）擦除闪存块时失败的次数，预示闪存芯片老化。
metrics.note_en: The number of failures when a Solid State Drive (SSD) erases flash memory blocks; an excessive number may indicate flash chip aging or an increase in bad blocks.

metrics.name: 主机读取次数
metrics.note: 操作系统从硬盘读取数据的总次数，属于硬盘使用量统计指标。
metrics.note_en: The total number of times the operating system reads data from the hard disk, which is a statistical indicator of hard disk usage with no direct fault warning significance.

metrics.name: 介质磨损百分比
metrics.note: 固态硬盘（SSD）专用指标，反映闪存芯片的磨损程度，100%表示完全磨损。
metrics.note_en: A core indicator dedicated to Solid State Drives (SSDs) that reflects the wear level of flash memory chips; the closer the value is to 100%, the shorter the lifespan.

metrics.name: PLL失锁计数
metrics.note: 锁相环（PLL）时钟同步失锁的次数，异常可能导致数据传输不稳定。
metrics.note_en: The number of times the hard disk clock synchronization module (Phase-Locked Loop, PLL) loses lock, which can cause data transmission timing errors.

metrics.name: 编程失败计数
metrics.note: 固态硬盘（SSD）向闪存块写入数据时失败的次数，反映闪存寿命。
metrics.note_en: The number of failures when a Solid State Drive (SSD) writes data (program operation) to flash memory blocks, which is a core indicator of flash memory health.

metrics.name: 重试缓冲区溢出计数
metrics.note: 硬盘读写失败后重试时，缓冲区溢出的次数，预示读写性能下降。
metrics.note_en: The number of times the data buffer overflows when the hard disk automatically retries after a read/write failure, indicating a decline in hard disk read/write performance or hardware failure.

metrics.name: 热节流状态
metrics.note: 硬盘因温度过高触发自动降速保护的状态，1为已触发，0为未触发。
metrics.note_en: The state where the hard disk triggers automatic speed reduction protection due to high temperature (1=triggered, 0=not triggered), which will cause slow read/write speeds after triggering.

metrics.name: 定时工作负载计时器
metrics.note: 记录硬盘在特定负载模式下的运行累计时间，评估硬盘工作强度。
metrics.note_en: Accumulates the operating time of the hard disk in a preset load mode, used to evaluate the long-term working intensity of the hard disk and assist in judging the wear rate.

metrics.name: 磨损均衡计数
metrics.note: 固态硬盘（SSD）磨损均衡算法的执行次数，延长硬盘整体寿命。
metrics.note_en: An indicator dedicated to Solid State Drives (SSDs) that records the number of executions of the wear leveling algorithm to ensure uniform wear of flash memory blocks and extend lifespan.

metrics.name: 设备退出状态
metrics.note: 硬盘SMART检测的退出状态码，0为正常完成，非0为检测异常。
metrics.note_en: The exit status code of the hard disk SMART self-test; 0 means the self-test is completed normally, and a non-zero value indicates self-test interruption or abnormality.

metrics.name: 设备健康状态
metrics.note: 硬盘整体健康状态标识，1为健康，0为不健康。
metrics.note_en: The overall health status identifier of the hard disk; 1=healthy (no fault warning), 0=unhealthy (potential faults exist).

metrics.name: 设备温度
metrics.note: 硬盘当前运行温度，主流硬盘安全工作范围为0-60℃。
metrics.note_en: The current operating temperature of the hard disk (in ℃); the safe operating range for mainstream hard disks is 0-60℃, and prolonged overheating will accelerate hardware aging.

collect.content:
# Read metrics from storage devices supporting S.M.A.R.T.
[[instances]]
    ## Optionally specify the path to the smartctl executable
    # path_smartctl = "/usr/bin/smartctl"

    ## Optionally specify the path to the nvme-cli executable
    # path_nvme = "/usr/bin/nvme"

    ## Optionally specify if vendor specific attributes should be propagated for NVMe disk case
    ## ["auto-on"] - automatically find and enable additional vendor specific disk info
    ## ["vendor1", "vendor2", ...] - e.g. "Intel" enable additional Intel specific disk info
    #  enable_extensions = ["auto-on"]

    ## On most platforms used cli utilities requires root access.
    ## Setting 'use_sudo' to true will make use of sudo to run smartctl or nvme-cli.
    ## Sudo must be configured to allow the telegraf user to run smartctl or nvme-cli
    ## without a password.
    # use_sudo = true

    ## Skip checking disks in this power mode. Defaults to
    ## "standby" to not wake up disks that have stopped rotating.
    ## See --nocheck in the man pages for smartctl.
    ## smartctl version 5.41 and 5.42 have faulty detection of
    ## power mode and might require changing this value to
    ## "never" depending on your disks.
    # nocheck = "standby"

    ## Gather all returned S.M.A.R.T. attribute metrics and the detailed
    ## information from each drive into the 'smart_attribute' measurement.
    # attributes = true

    ## Optionally specify devices to exclude from reporting if disks auto-discovery is performed.
    # excludes = [ "/dev/pass6" ]

    ## Optionally specify devices and device type, if unset
    ## a scan (smartctl --scan and smartctl --scan -d nvme) for S.M.A.R.T. devices will be done
    ## and all found will be included except for the excluded in excludes.
    # devices = [ "/dev/ada0 -d atacam", "/dev/nvme0"]
    # devices = ["dev/nvme0 -d nvme", "/dev/nvme0"]

    ## Timeout for the cli command to complete.
      timeout = "30s"

    ## Optionally call smartctl and nvme-cli with a specific concurrency policy.
    ## By default, smartctl and nvme-cli are called in separate threads (goroutines) to gather disk attributes.
    ## Some devices (e.g. disks in RAID arrays) may have access limitations that require sequential reading of
    ## SMART data - one individual array drive at the time. In such case please set this configuration option
    ## to "sequential" to get readings for all drives.
    ## valid options: concurrent, sequential
    # read_method = "concurrent"
